body_es: AWS ofrece múltiples componentes de seguridad especializados para proteger recursos en diferentes capas de la infraestructura y aplicación. Los Security Groups actúan como firewalls virtuales sofisticados que controlan el tráfico de entrada y salida de instancias EC2 a nivel de red. Las listas de control de acceso de red (NACL) proporcionan control de acceso granular a nivel de subred. AWS WAF protege aplicaciones web contra ataques comunes y sofisticados como inyección SQL y XSS. AWS Secrets Manager gestiona credenciales, contraseñas y secretos de forma segura con encriptación integrada. AWS KMS proporciona gestión centralizada de claves de encriptación para proteger datos en reposo y en tránsito. AWS VPN y AWS PrivateLink permiten conectividad segura entre redes. AWS Certificate Manager administra automáticamente certificados SSL/TLS. AWS DDoS Protection (Shield) protege contra ataques distribuidos de negación de servicio. La combinación estratégica de estos componentes crea una arquitectura de seguridad multicapa robusta. La implementacion de estas capas multiples de seguridad requiere revision regular y actualizacion continua para mantener efectividad ante nuevas amenazas.
body_en: AWS offers multiple specialized security components to protect resources at different layers of infrastructure and applications. Security Groups act as sophisticated virtual firewalls controlling inbound and outbound traffic for EC2 instances at the network layer. Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) provide granular access control at the subnet level. AWS WAF protects web applications from common and sophisticated attacks such as SQL injection and XSS. AWS Secrets Manager securely manages credentials, passwords, and secrets with built-in encryption. AWS KMS provides centralized encryption key management to protect data at rest and in transit. AWS VPN and AWS PrivateLink enable secure connectivity between networks. AWS Certificate Manager automatically manages SSL/TLS certificates. AWS DDoS Protection (Shield) protects against distributed denial-of-service attacks. The strategic combination of these components creates a robust multi-layered security architecture. These security components work together in layers: Security Groups and NACLs control network access, AWS WAF protects application layer, Secrets Manager and KMS protect data, and AWS CloudTrail audits all actions. AWS Shield Standard provides automatic DDoS protection for all customers at no additional cost, while Shield Advanced offers enhanced protection with DDoS cost assurance. Building security layers ensures that if one layer is compromised, other layers continue protecting sensitive data. Regular security assessments and penetration testing validate the effectiveness of these controls. Organizations should implement AWS Config rules to monitor that security controls remain properly configured and enabled continuously.
example_code:
# Create a Security Group
aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name web-sg --description "Security group for web servers"

# Add inbound rule to Security Group
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-12345678   --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0

# Create a secret in Secrets Manager
aws secretsmanager create-secret --name db-password --secret-string '{"username":"admin","password":"MyP@ssw0rd"}'

# Enable AWS Shield Advanced
aws shield subscribe --subscription
